build_window_partition: partition a tensor into non-overlapping windows with padding support for vision transformer attention
build_window_unpartition: unpartition windowed tensors back to original spatial dimensions removing padding
build_add_decomposed_rel_pos: add decomposed relative positional embeddings to an attention map from mvitv2
build_get_abs_pos: compute absolute positional embeddings and resize them to match input spatial dimensions
build_patch_embed: create a patch embedding module that converts images to patch tokens using a 2d convolution
